# Figma

> > Figma is a collaborative design and prototyping platform featuring AI-powered tools like Figma Make, FigJam for team collaboration, and Dev Mode for design-to-development workflows.

Figma provides end-to-end design solutions from concept to launch, including no-code AI builders, design systems, and enterprise-grade collaboration tools. The platform serves organizations like Philips, Mazda, Ruggable, and Twitter in accelerating digital transformation and design-driven development.

## Key Topics

- Figma Make
- FigJam
- Dev Mode
- Design Systems
- No-code Development
- AI-powered Design Tools
- Digital Transformation

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [Figma Solutions - From Concept to Launch, All in One Place](https://www.figma.com/solutions): Main solutions overview featuring Figma AI, FigJam, and design tools
- [Figma Enterprise Plan](https://www.figma.com/enterprise/plan): Figma Enterprise plan featuring security, design systems, and team collaboration
- [AI Website Builder - Prompt to Website in Seconds | Figma](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-website-builder): Figma Make AI website builder using natural language prompts, no coding

## AI-Powered App Builders

- [AI financial dashboard generator | Figma](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-financial-dashboard-generator): Figma Make AI financial dashboard generator for data-rich interfaces
- [AI Contact Manager App Builder | Build with Figma Make](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-crm-app-builder): Figma Make AI-powered CRM and contact manager app builder, no code required
- [Free AI Meditation App Builder | Build with Figma Make](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-meditation-app-builder): Figma Make AI-powered no-code meditation app builder and prototyping tool
- [AI Employee Directory App Builder | Build with Figma Make](https://www.figma.com/solutions/ai-employee-directory-app-builder): Figma Make AI employee directory app builder with no-code prototyping

## Design Tools & Resources

- [Color Picker from Image & Hex Color Picker | Figma](https://www.figma.com/color-picker): Free color picker tool supporting HEX, RGB, HSL, HSB codes and palettes
- [Free Organizational Chart Maker | FigJam by Figma](https://www.figma.com/figjam/organizational-chart): FigJam org chart maker with AI features and collaboration templates
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator - Create Custom Text for Free | Figma](https://www.figma.com/lorem-ipsum-generator): Free Lorem Ipsum Generator tool for adding placeholder text to designs
- [Monospace fonts](https://www.figma.com/font-types/monospace-fonts): Guide to monospace fonts like IBM Plex Mono, Ubuntu Mono, and Roboto Mono
